patternAdaptation.setting: A sorting floor between the warehouse shelf and the street
patternAdaptation.metaphor: Each lane is a pocket that holds the parcels bound for one street
patternAdaptation.openingImage: One parcel on the shelf with a blank label
patternAdaptation.handoffImage: The parcel in the pocket of lane 3, ready for the van to the door

artDirection.visualPremise: The route of a parcel told as felt pieces sewn onto one board

visualGrammar.drawing: Cut felt shapes with thick dark edges and a light stitch
visualGrammar.depth: Two layers: the board and the pieces sewn onto it
visualGrammar.typography: Short sewn tags next to the object they name
visualGrammar.space: The route runs left to right and keeps the right third free for the next move
visualGrammar.camera: Moves only to follow the parcel or to read its label

artDirection.connectorGrammar: One approved felt arrow with an outer edge, a fabric core, a stitch, and a sewn head, laid on a reserved lane for static relations only

objectLexicon.role: The box the customer is waiting for
objectLexicon.shapeRationale: A taped box with a label face, so the label can be read and changed
objectLexicon.result: The viewer can read where the parcel goes and when it arrives

objectLexicon.role: The belt that reads labels and turns each parcel into its lane
objectLexicon.shapeRationale: A belt with gates at each lane, so the turn into one lane can be seen
operations: turns a parcel into a lane
objectLexicon.result: The viewer can see that the label alone decides the lane

motionLexicon.motion: travels along the belt into its pocket
one gate swings across the belt

scenePromise.newVisualDiscovery: The blank label is the reason the parcel waits
scenePromise.handoff: The parcel moves under the printer

scenePromise.newVisualDiscovery: The label decides which pocket takes the parcel
scenePromise.handoff: The pocket of lane 3 holds the parcel

stageTheme.containerPolicy: Pockets appear only where a lane holds parcels until the van leaves
stageTheme.labelPolicy: Pockets of the same kind in one scene share the top offset and the label baseline
stageTheme.connectorPolicy: Only for static relations; never laid over the route of a moving parcel
stageTheme.tracePolicy: Only outlines made from accepted PNGs, and never an outline shown alone

staticAssets.staticRoleReason: A sewn felt box reads as the parcel itself; a shape drawn in Remotion would read as an icon
The belt and its gates need the felt material of the board to read as one machine
forbiddenExplanationWork: stand in for a lane pocket
